title: Add cook mode launch controls in recipe detail
description: Add the `Cook now` action to the recipe detail bottom bar and wire full-screen presentation state from `RecipeDetailSheet`, including the no-steps gating rule and passing the locked scale into cook mode.
acceptance_criteria: `RecipeBottomBar` exposes a `Cook now` action alongside the existing bottom-bar actions.
The action is disabled or otherwise suppressed when the parsed recipe has no `.step` content across sections.
`RecipeDetailSheet` presents cook mode via `.fullScreenCover` and passes the parsed recipe plus current scale into the new flow.
